info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Withdrawal API allows organizations to efficiently manage and withdraw applications submitted by candidates. By using this endpoint, HR professionals can remove candidates' applications from consideration in a straightforward manner. This operation is essential for maintaining an up-to-date pool of candidates and ensuring a smooth recruitment process. It is primarily used by recruitment teams and hiring managers who need to handle candidate applications dynamically and respond to changing circumstances in the hiring landscape.

delete.description: This operation allows a user to withdraw their application. It will remove the application from consideration and will not allow further processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a withdrawal operation for applications. It must conform to the specified schema detailed below.

200.description: The withdrawal request was processed successfully.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the DELETE operation to withdraw an application.

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the withdrawal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: The current state of the withdrawal request.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the withdrawal request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the withdrawal operation.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the successful withdrawal operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the withdrawal request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the withdrawal request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal request was initiated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit information related to the withdrawal operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time for the DELETE operation in milliseconds.

schema.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, in milliseconds.
